problem: Given $P(A)=\frac{1}{3}$, $P(B)=\frac{3}{8}$, $P(A\cup B)=\frac{17}{24}$, determine whether $A$ and $B$ are mutually exclusive events.

choices.value: $A$ and $B$ are not mutually exclusive events, since $P(A)\ne P(B)$
$A$ and $B$ are mutually exclusive events, since $P(A\cap B)=0$
$A$ and $B$ are not mutually exclusive events, since $P(A\cap B)\ne 0$
$A$ and $B$ are not mutually exclusive events, since $P(A)\cdot P(B)\ne P(A\cup B)$
$A$ and $B$ are not mutually exclusive events, since $P(A)\cdot P(B)<P(A\cup B)$
